newsitem.title: THAILAND: Siam Commercial Bank plans raise funds.
newsitem.headline: Siam Commercial Bank plans raise funds.

text.p: Thailand's Siam Commercial Bank said on Monday that it plans to secure long term debt worth 8.75 billion baht and set up a medium term notes programme worth US$1.5 billion.
The bank said in a filing to the Thai stock exchange that both the programmes were discussed by its board of directors at a meeting on Monday.
The bank said the 8.5 billion baht would be raised in the form of long term subordinated debt or its equivalent in other currencies for a period not exceeding 30 years.
The medium term notes programme would be realised through the issue of unidentified debt instruments in foreign currency or in baht, also for a period not exceeding 30 years, it added.
